declarations.name: Erdos1040.measure_neg_le_margin_add_sq_eLpNorm
declarations.source_statement: For any measure on the complex plane, real functions f and g with almost-everywhere strongly measurable difference, and positive nonnegative-real margin delta, the measure where f is negative is at most the measure where g is below delta plus the squared extended nonnegative-real L2 seminorm (possibly infinite) of f minus g divided by delta squared. This is a conditional error-transfer inequality, not the existence of a suitable g or approximation.

review.notes: Independent source-and-exact-signature review; see formal/reviews/PREFLIGHT_AREA_TRANSFER_REVIEW.md. Arbitrary measure, explicitly measurable difference, positive finite margin, strict negative and low-margin sets, and possibly infinite ENNReal L2 norm match. This is only a conditional sign-transfer estimate; no approximant or useful finite error is constructed.

  MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable.{0, 0} (fun z => HSub.hSub.{0, 0, 0} (f z) (g z)) μ →
    ∀ (δ : NNReal),
      LT.lt.{0} 0 δ →
        LE.le.{0} (μ (Set.ofPred.{0} fun z => LT.lt.{0} (f z) 0))
          (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (μ (Set.ofPred.{0} fun z => LT.lt.{0} (g z) ↑δ))
            (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (HPow.hPow.{0, 0, 0} (Inv.inv.{0} ↑δ) 2)
              (HPow.hPow.{0, 0, 0} (MeasureTheory.eLpNorm.{0, 0} (fun z => HSub.hSub.{0, 0, 0} (f z) (g z)) 2 μ) 2)))

declarations.name: Erdos1040.exists_roots_simultaneous_potential_approximation
declarations.source_statement: For compact planar source S and observation K, compact exterior observation subtype E disjoint from S, a probability on S, and positive area and exterior tolerances, there is one positive finite list of complex roots all in S whose actual atomicLogPotential class approximates the Bochner area-L2 potential integral and whose actual atomicLogPotential values uniformly approximate the scalar source log-distance integral at every point of E. The exact same roots meet both strict error bounds.

One positive list of complex roots in original S gives the actual atomic-potential L2 class bound and every-point exterior scalar-integral bound. The area reference remains the Bochner L2-class integral; no unproved overlapping-source pointwise identity is inferred.

    ∀ (hK : IsCompact.{0} K),
      Disjoint.{0} S E →
        ∀ (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure.{0} ↑S) [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure.{0} μ] (εA εE : ℝ),
          LT.lt.{0} 0 εA →
            LT.lt.{0} 0 εE →

                                (∫ (w : ↑S), Real.log (Norm.norm.{0} (HSub.hSub.{0, 0, 0} ↑z ↑w)) ∂μ)))
                            εE
